style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D): a small round fuzzy pale-green cave moth with dusty cream wings edged in soft yellow, big dark round eyes, feathery antennae and a faint glow of yellow spores dusting off its wings, a clean dark outline, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights and shading. Match the palette, outline weight and rendering of the reference image (a cave bat) but draw this moth. Side view, the creature facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no shadow, no effects.
